description: Finds players by full or partial name (case-insensitive) and returns each match's exact player_id ("First Last#POS"), team and position. Use it first whenever you have a name but not the id the other tools need. Defenses match by team code or nickname too ("TB", "Bucs", "Tampa Bay DST"). Free plan.

name.description: Full or partial player name, case-insensitive. For a defense, a team code or nickname works ("TB", "Bucs", "Tampa Bay DST").
